profile.projectReadme:
# College Attendance Management System
Collaborative college project built by a team of 4.
Repository: github.com/riya-sharma/college-attendance-system (fictional)

## Modules
1. Authentication & Faculty Auth (Built by teammate A)
2. Attendance Schema & SQL Engine (Built by Riya Sharma)
3. Web UI Templates (Built by teammate B)
4. Notification Service (Built by teammate C)

## Database Architecture
SQLite / PostgreSQL compatible schema with strict unique constraints on student IDs and session timestamps to prevent duplicate submissions.

interviewHistory.question: How did you prevent duplicate attendance records in your college project schema?
interviewHistory.userAnswer: I created a composite unique constraint on the student ID and session date columns in the attendance_records table. If an insert occurs with the same pair on the same day, the database raises an integrity error which the API handles gracefully.

feedback.whatWasClear: Precise explanation of the database constraint mechanism (composite unique index) and why it works.
feedback.whatNeedsImprovement: Could mention how the Flask backend surfaces that constraint error to the user without crashing.
feedback.practicalSuggestion: State: "In SQLite/Postgres, UNIQUE(student_id, session_date) enforces idempotency at the storage engine level."
feedback.followUpQuestion: What HTTP status code did your Flask route return when that duplicate error was caught?

weakAreas.topic: Explaining Flask Error Handling & HTTP Status Codes
weakAreas.details: Practise bridging the database constraint exception to the REST API response layer (returning 409 Conflict instead of 500).
